segments.text: Hello friends, welcome to your own channel HSC StudyGuide
segments.zh: 朋友们好，欢迎来到你们自己的频道 HSE Study Guide。

segments.text: Today in this video we are going to talk about GFCI
segments.zh: 今天这期视频我们要讲 GFCI，

segments.text: i.e. Ground fault circuit interrupters
segments.zh: 也就是接地故障断路器。

segments.text: So let's start the video
segments.zh: 那我们开始吧。

segments.text: Now let's know what is this GFCI i.e. Ground fault circuit interrupters are
segments.zh: 现在我们来了解什么是 GFCI，也就是接地故障断路器。

segments.text: So ground fault happens when the seed tool or electrical system breaks in low resistance grounding path
segments.zh: 接地故障是在工具或电气系统的低电阻接地路径断开时发生的，

segments.text: At that time the electrical current can take the alternative path to go into the ground
segments.zh: 这时电流可能会走另一条路径流入大地，

segments.text: That too through the user
segments.zh: 而且是经过使用者，

segments.text: Because of which serious injury or death can also happen
segments.zh: 因此可能造成重伤甚至死亡。

segments.text: GFCI i.e. Ground fault circuit interrupter is a fast acting circuit breaker
segments.zh: GFCI 也就是接地故障断路器，是一种快速动作的断路器，

segments.text: In which in the state of ground fault a 1 by 40 second light is designed to be switched off
segments.zh: 在发生接地故障时，它被设计成能在 1/40 秒内切断电源，

segments.text: When the amount of current comes in, means the amount of current is approximately 5 mA
segments.zh: 当电流量出现差值，也就是电流差约为 5 mA 时，

segments.text: If the difference comes in, then the GFCI interrupters there
segments.zh: 如果出现了这个差值，GFCI 就会在那里切断电路，

segments.text: To prevent the electrical incident, GFCI is rotated there
segments.zh: 为了防止发生触电事故，GFCI 会在那里动作，

segments.text: That is, it quickly trips there because of it
segments.zh: 也就是它会因此在那里迅速跳闸。

segments.text: If we install it properly or maintain it
segments.zh: 如果我们正确地安装或维护它，

segments.text: Then as soon as we plug in the faulty tool, it works quickly
segments.zh: 那么一旦我们插上有故障的工具，它就会迅速起作用。

segments.text: GFCI i.e. it will not protect you from the line contact hazards
segments.zh: GFCI 也就是说，它不能保护你免受线间接触危害，

segments.text: Although it will protect you from the electric shock hazards
segments.zh: 不过它能保护你免受电击危害，

segments.text: Or because of the ground fault
segments.zh: 或者由接地故障引起的危害，

segments.text: Till here it will protect you against the fires, against overheating
segments.zh: 甚至它还能保护你防止火灾、防止过热，

segments.text: Or in the destruction of the wire insulations
segments.zh: 或者防止电线绝缘层损坏。

segments.text: Chilip knows about the types of GFCI
segments.zh: 我们来了解一下 GFCI 的类型。

segments.text: Here GFCI is available in several types
segments.zh: GFCI 有好几种类型，

segments.text: So it comes in some variations
segments.zh: 所以它有一些不同的形式。

segments.text: So the best type of it is the receptable type
segments.zh: 其中最好的一种是插座型，

segments.text: What happens in this is that one or more than that
segments.zh: 它是这样的：在一个或多个

segments.text: Which is the receptable outlet
segments.zh: 插座出口中，

segments.text: Then the device in GFCI is included here
segments.zh: 就包含了 GFCI 装置，

segments.text: Such devices are becoming very popular here
segments.zh: 这类装置现在越来越受欢迎，

segments.text: Because its cost is very low because of it
segments.zh: 因为它的成本很低。

segments.text: Then the second type is the portable type
segments.zh: 第二种是便携型，

segments.text: So the portable type GFCI comes in several types
segments.zh: 便携型 GFCI 有好几种，

segments.text: And all these designs are designed to be easily transported
segments.zh: 所有这些设计都便于搬运。

segments.text: Some are designed to be able to plug in the existing non-GFCI outlet
segments.zh: 有些设计成可以插到现有的非 GFCI 插座上，

segments.text: Or to be connected with the cord
segments.zh: 或者用电线连接，

segments.text: Or to be able to plug it in the plug arrangement
segments.zh: 或者可以用插头插接的方式来使用。

segments.text: In the portable type, the no voltage release device is also included
segments.zh: 便携型里还包含失压脱扣装置，

segments.text: Which will disconnect the power from the outlet
segments.zh: 它会切断插座的电源，

segments.text: If the conductor is there, then it is in that condition
segments.zh: 如果有导线断开，就在那种情况下切断。

segments.text: Then the third type is the cord-connected type
segments.zh: 第三种是电线连接型，

segments.text: So the cord-connected type of GFCI is a plug attachment
segments.zh: 电线连接型的 GFCI 是一种插头附件，

segments.text: Which is included in the GFCI module
segments.zh: 里面包含 GFCI 模块，

segments.text: This protects the cord or any equipment that is attached to the cord
segments.zh: 它能保护电线以及连接在电线上的任何设备。

segments.text: The non-standard appearance in the attachment plug is also included in the test and recent button
segments.zh: 这种附件插头外观不同于标准插头，上面还带有测试和复位按钮。

segments.text: Like in the portable type, the no voltage release device is included
segments.zh: 和便携型一样，它也包含失压脱扣装置，

segments.text: In that, it disconnects the power
segments.zh: 在那种情况下它会切断电源，

segments.text: If any conductor is there, then it is in that condition
segments.zh: 如果有导线断开，就在那种情况下切断。

segments.text: So in this way, you must have come to know about these three types of GFCI
segments.zh: 这样你们就了解了这三种类型的 GFCI。

segments.zh: 朋友们，希望你们通过这期视频了解了 GFCI，

segments.zh: 也就是接地故障断路器。
